Copy: Branch Accounts Team
To the Rewards Administration Desk:
Our practice keeps a rewards account for each of its two offices. The Eastgate account shows 5,600 credits, of which 3,000 were awarded under the spring bonus offer rather than earned on purchases. The Ambleside account shows 2,600 credits, all earned on supply orders. Two years ago we claimed a coffee machine for the Eastgate break room.

Combining Rewards Balances: Program Rules
For member businesses holding accounts at more than one branch.
A. Who may ask, and how
Both accounts must be registered to the same member business, and the request must be put in writing by the person named as the contact on each account. Requests from other staff are returned without action.
B. Credit that carries across
Credit earned on supply orders carries across in full. Credit awarded through a bonus offer carries across at half its value, and the reduction is applied before the two totals are added.
C. What a combined balance cannot buy
A combined balance may not be used for any category supplied by an outside company rather than from the program's own stock. Those items must be claimed against a single account.
D. Timing
Requests are settled within ten business days. Credit that expires during that period cannot be restored.
Questions may be sent to the Rewards Administration Desk.

Product Development Notes
Home Panel Findings Lead to Two Design Changes
Two features of the cordless sweeper made by Hollingsworth Home Products were altered after the company's first home trial cycle closed in March.
The dust container on the sample unit was enlarged, and the power switch was moved from the body of the machine to the handle. Comments about the noise of the motor were also common, but the motor itself was left unchanged.
Ninety households took part, each using a preproduction unit for six weeks in place of its own cleaning equipment and filing three short written reports.
"A machine behaves differently in a home than it does in our testing rooms," said Nigel Braithwaite, who manages the panel program at the research office. "Neither change would have been made without the panel."
The cycle now under way differs in one respect. Members are being placed in two groups, and one group will keep its sample unit for twelve weeks instead of six.
